title: The same-url retry budget never resets - MPI-460's three attempts are a per-file lifetime, not three failures without progress
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-717 - One slow install, three defects on the local download path (consolidation sweep 2026-09-10). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-717/plan.md. FileDownloader._attempts is incremented on every same-url retry and reset nowhere, so MPI-460's [2s, 5s, 15s] backoff is spent once per FILE, however much progress lands between blips. Captured 2026-09-10: qwen3-8b-clip resumed from 2.56 GB after retry 1 and from 3.42 GB after retry 2, six minutes and 0.86 GB apart - one more blip and 3.42 GB on disk goes terminal. Reset the budget on progress since the last retry; the zero-bytes MPI-427 gate stays. Code trace, not executed - repro is step one. Behaviour change, so it lands AFTER MPI-716's telemetry.
